verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents caching of `act()`, `observe()` and `extract()` results to cut LLM cost and latency [stagehand-docs-6]. It also documents built-in auto-caching that turns agent-discovered workflows into deterministic scripts running 10-100x faster [stagehand-docs-29], with recorded selectors that `selfHeal` only re-infers when they break [stagehand-docs-5]. The older HN remark about regenerating Playwright every run [stagehand-comm-8] describes default self-healing behavior and does not concretely contradict the documented caching. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of cache hits and cost savings, clear docs on cache storage and invalidation (local vs. server-side), and explicit export of reusable generated code.
